_comment: Frame table for the t-59 office sample, round 20 (extraction era). Every region below is a direct pixel crop from a boss-generated owned-source sheet under projects/bureau/references/office/ (THE LAW, t-54, 2026-08-16 amendment) — cleaned (JPEG-ringing despeckle + 40-color median-cut quantize, no redraw) and scaled 3x nearest-neighbor. No pixel in atlas.png was hand-drawn.

sourceSheets.typing: cast/sheet-agent-anims-a.jpg, row 2 ("AGENT TYPING LOOP"), native grid cells at column index 1,2,3 (0-based) of an 8x3 176x256 grid, y-trimmed to 321-512 (was 256-512: the first 65px dropped a bleeding leg/foot fragment from the walk row above, an artifact of the sheet's own imperfect row spacing, not introduced by the crop)
sourceSheets.idle: cast/sheet-agent-anims-b.jpg, row 2 (front-facing standing loop), same column index 1,2 and same y-trim (321-512) as the typing sheet
sourceSheets.lamp: cast/sheet-agent-anims-b.jpg, row 3 (back-facing loop), the lit floor lamp prop beside the last cell (native crop x1168-1232,y540-768 of the 1408x768 sheet)
sourceSheets.wallmon: cast/sheet-agent-anims-a.jpg, the wall-mounted terminal prop centered above the row boundary (native crop x490-635,y0-90)
